args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks (error rate 0.18) after the v2.3.1 deploy. Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback tool was unavailable (503), so the rollback was performed via deploy of v2.3.0, which verified as rolled_out in all regions.

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed** the issue: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` (unhealthy, 0.18 error rate) across all three regions. The most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.

2. **Rolled back**: The `rollback` tool was persistently unavailable (503), so I performed the rollback by deploying `v2.3.0` to all regions. This verified as `rolled_out` in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`) for `checkout-api`, describing the health-check failures and the rollback action taken, and paged the on-call engineer.
